outcome_evidence: The robot approaches and aligns with the drawer handle in frames 0–86 (left_ego_image and wrist_image), then pulls the drawer outward in frames 102–120 (image and left_ego_image). The extended drawer and exposed opening remain visible after the gripper releases and retreats in frames 127–159 (image and left_ego_image).
